parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS node.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network peer connection.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the network peer connection.

parameters.name: NetworkIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the networks involved in the connection. The query does not distinguish between the requester and accepter.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for the returned results. Default: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default: **10**. Valid values: **10** to **100**.
